Container.Name: bth-probe
Container.Overview: Checks that MikroTik Back To Home works as the way in when Tailscale is down. Connects as one BTH user through the MikroTik relay, like a phone would, and every few minutes tests the tunnel, DNS through the BTH resolver, and the admin UIs. Prometheus metrics on /metrics. Needs NET_ADMIN and the host's wireguard module. Put BTH_PRIVATE_KEY in the env-file named in Extra Parameters, not here.
Container.Requires: A MikroTik Back To Home user for the probe (allow-lan=yes); its private key in the env-file.

Config.Name: BTH_SERVER_PUBLIC_KEY
Config.Description: /ip cloud vpn-public-key (changes when BTH is revoked/rotated)

Config.Name: BTH_ENDPOINT
Config.Description: vpn-dns-name:vpn-port from /ip cloud, e.g. xxxx.vpn.mynetname.net:17007 (port changes on rotation)

Config.Name: DNS_NAMES
Config.Description: Space-separated names that must resolve to private IPs via the BTH resolver (empty = built-in defaults)

Config.Name: HTTP_TARGETS
Config.Description: Space-separated host:port HTTPS targets (empty = built-in defaults)
